name: Third-body gravity and rotating-frame kernels
purpose: Verify Sun/Earth differential gravity, centrifugal acceleration, Coriolis acceleration, and frame-update consistency.
production_capability: Orbit-enabled branches of Moon::TotalParticleAcceleration and amps_time_step.
configuration: _EXOSPHERE__ORBIT_CALCUALTION__MODE_=ON with an authoritative SPICE kernel set.
independent_reference: Direct differential-gravity equations and -Omega cross (Omega cross r)-2 Omega cross v identities.
units: m, s, m s^-2, rad s^-1
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO/SO_FROZEN with explicit UTC-to-ET conversion.
procedure: Compare isolated terms and a one-step frame update against independent vector algebra and SPICE transforms.
acceptance_criteria: Vector errors <=1e-12 relative and transform orthogonality <=1e-13; tolerances reviewed for SPICE precision.
expected_pass_result: Each inertial/non-inertial term and frame update agrees independently.
data_hashes: not available in current SPICE=off configuration
status_semantics: SKIPPED while orbit mode or authoritative kernels are unavailable.
skip_reason: The current Moon configuration has SPICE/orbit calculation disabled, and the enabled branch still contains unresolved MSGR_HCI legacy frame references.
missing_capability: Qualified Moon ephemeris/frame configuration and callable termwise diagnostic.
